```pycon
── CHECK 1: monthly series sums to the headline total ──
  sum(months) = 3039   headline total = 3039
  PASS

── CHECK 2: average order value = total / orders ──
  total/orders = 2.37   displayed = 2.37
  PASS

── CHECK 3: composition shares sum to 100% ──
  sum(shares) = 100.0%   PASS

── CHECK 4: are the KPI deltas mutually consistent? ──
  given total +12.4% and orders +8.1%,
  implied AOV delta = +3.98%
  displayed AOV delta = -3.9%
  gap = 7.88 pts  ->  FAIL: deltas contradict each other

── CHECK 5: do the deltas imply a prior-period series? ──
  implied prior total   = 2703.7
  implied prior orders  = 1187.8
  -> no prior-period series exists in the placeholders (see note)
```
